hiveSql:
select 
                            combi_id, 
                            cast(null as string) as trace_id, 
                            '1' as enabled_flag, 
                            'SYSTEM' as create_by, 
                            cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as date)  as create_date, 
                            'SYSTEM' as update_by, 
                            cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') as date)  as update_date, 
                            concat('STRA_',combi_id) as prod_code, 
                            '1' as sys_sts, 
                            combi_name as prod_sht, 
                            '2' as prod_source, 
                            combi_name as prod_name, 
                            cast(null as string) as inv_typ_comi, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_srp, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_out_cnf, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_cash_magr, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_qdii, 
                            cast(current_date() as date)  as valu_cnfm_dt, 
                            cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(setup_date,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') as date) as found_dt, 
                            99991231 as end_dt, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_fof_mom, 
                            '1' as prd_cald, 
                            cast(null as string) as track_idx, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_citd_amor, 
                            cast(null as string) as is_fcode, 
                            '102001' as pfm_basi, 
                            'STRA' as sys_rs_id, 
                            '102001' as contr_basi, 
                            cast('9999-12-31' as date) as clr_dt, 
                            cast(null as string) as fund_typi, 
                            cast(null as string) as fund_typii, 
                            combi_name as prd_full_name, 
                            combi_name as prd_name, 
                            '3' as prd_typ, 
                            cast(null as string) as lst_nav_date, 
                            '102001' as jrgc_basi
                            from ${srcdbname}.ims_t_icm_combi
